title: Learned code-distance regularization for a logical function bank
hypothesis: For eight fixed logical linear functions, a 500-step minimum-distance codebook regularizer will reduce route error under Gaussian code noise at sigma=.2 by at least 25% versus random orthogonal addresses, with total serialized inference payload <=1.05x compact raw-ID payload in both development seeds.
physical_object: one charged bank of eight 16x16 linear expert matrices
mirror_coordinate: raw binary, random orthogonal, random spherical or metric-regularized continuous address vector
logical_multiplicity: eight fixed callable functions selected by a noisy continuous/discrete address
controls: native metric-learning minimum-distance codebook identical to Mirror formulation

task.type: synthetic routed function bank with Gaussian address noise
task.function_weights: fixed random 16x16 matrices shared across every code method
task.decoder: nearest Euclidean codeword; selected expert applies its matrix to the same query vector

regularizer.objective: mean squared hinge on pairwise Euclidean code distance below 1.45
regularizer.initialization: seeded random unit vectors; same seed offset as random-sphere control

selection_metrics: decoder operation proxy and wall time
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: prohibited without numbered amendment; both development seeds run once under frozen code

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: explicit float codebook rows when used
storage.compact_id: raw binary IDs are represented implicitly by the fixed decoder metadata; no codebook array is stored

gates.PROMISING: At sigma=.2, distance-regularized address route error is at least 25% lower than random orthogonal codes, and its full payload is <=1.05x raw-ID bytes in both seeds; output replay passes. Report native metric-learning attribution separately.
gates.FAIL: The no-noise function upper is valid, but robustness/byte gate fails or ordinary metric-learning/native code geometry fully explains the result.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: No-noise function replay or serialized metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic independent linear functions and Gaussian address noise only; no trained router or natural task claim.
All expert matrices, codebook rows and metadata are paid.
No codebook combinations are counted as additional capacity.
Report the valid zero-noise function replay as a necessary screen; do not interpret fixed synthetic requests as learned function capacity.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless the frozen PROMISING gates pass and native attribution is resolved.
